name: Nationality by Marriage (Article 10 -- Foreign Wife of a Moroccan Husband)

qualifying_event.description: Article 10 of the Code de la Nationalité Marocaine allows a foreign woman married to a Moroccan man to acquire Moroccan nationality by declaration, filed with the Minister of Justice during the marriage, after at least 5 years of the couple's habitual and regular joint residence in Morocco. This is a gendered provision: the Code does not extend an equivalent simplified declaration route to a foreign man married to a Moroccan woman, who must instead use the standard naturalisation route (ma_naturalisation.json).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; declaration filed with the Minister of Justice; proof of at least 5 years' joint habitual residence in Morocco.

requirements.blocker_text: Available only to a foreign woman married to a Moroccan man (Article 10) -- there is no equivalent simplified declaration route for a foreign man married to a Moroccan woman under this Code.
At least 5 years of the couple's habitual and regular joint residence ('résidence habituelle et régulière au Maroc du ménage') in Morocco.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of joint habitual residence in Morocco during the marriage.

requirements.blocker_text: A declaration must be filed with the Minister of Justice while the marriage subsists; nationality is acquired from the date of declaration, and a later dissolution of the marriage does not invalidate an already-filed declaration.

evidence_required.document: Declaration filed with the Minister of Justice
Proof of 5 years' joint habitual residence

sources.title: NATLEX (ILO) -- Code de la Nationalité Marocaine, consolidated 16 May 2024, Article 10: declaration route for a foreign wife of a Moroccan husband, 5-year joint-residence requirement, declaration filed with the Minister of Justice, effect from declaration date

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Morocco). This route is explicitly gendered in the primary legislative text itself (Article 10 applies only to a foreign woman marrying a Moroccan man) -- modeled precisely rather than smoothed into gender-neutral language, consistent with this dataset's practice of representing a law's actual asymmetries accurately (see also Austria's citizenship-by-descent asymmetry built earlier). A foreign man married to a Moroccan woman has no equivalent simplified declaration path and must use the standard 5-year naturalisation route in ma_naturalisation.json instead, without any marriage-based reduction to that route's own residence requirement (both happen to be 5 years, but Article 11's standard track is not itself shortened by marriage for a foreign husband).
